title_zh: 从 Transformer 构建“轻量级”Token图的直接方法

authors: João Pimentel；Joana Amorim；Frank Rudzicz
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 脑电基础大模型
abstract_zh: 尽管 Transformer 是从文本中提取信息的标准，但它们具有相当大的局限性，这使得它们对于某些任务而言并不是最佳选择。图神经网络 (GNN) 是一种替代方案，可以缓解其中一些限制，最近的工作重点是将来自预训练语言模型 (PLM) 的信息与图结构相结合。然而，大多数现有方法使用固定大小的滑动窗口来构造图，忽略了单词之间的长距离关系。我们提出了一种内存高效的方法来构建令牌图，该方法通过 Transformer 的注意力系数利用 Transformer 内部的语义和关系信息，从而减轻使用滑动窗口的限制。此外，每个图表都可以完全...
abstract_en: Even though Transformers are the standard to extract information from text, they have considerable limitations that make them sub-optimal for certain tasks. Graph neural networks (GNNs) are an alternative that mitigate some of these limitations, with recent work focusing on combining information from pre-trained language models (PLMs) with graph structures. However, most existing methods use fixed-size sliding windows to construct graphs, ignoring long-distance relationships between words. We propose a memory-efficient method to construct token graphs that exploits semantic and relational information inside Transformers via their attention coefficients, mitigating the limitations of using sliding windows. Additionally, each graph can fully encode documents longer than the Transformer’s context window via a chunk-and-stride mechanism, while also reducing memory usage. Our method surpasses the performance of sliding windows when both approaches are compared under the same model architecture, particularly in longer documents, and reaches statistically identical performance in shorter ones. It also surpasses GNN-based state-of-the-art techniques. When compared with fine-tuning, our method reaches marginally lower performance in documents that fit inside the pre-trained model’s context window. However, our method surpasses fine-tuning in documents that do not fit inside these windows, which comes as a result of fully encoding each document using our chunk-and-stride mechanism.

title_zh: 大语言模型智能体人之间自愿与秘密工具勾结
title_en: Voluntary Collusion with Secret Tools in Competing LLM Agents
authors: Frank Rudzicz；Xijie Zeng
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；强化学习与决策优化
abstract_zh: 即使某个工具被明确描述为不公平且对他人有害，表面上注重安全的大语言模型智能体人仍然会自愿参与秘密共谋，只要这样做可以带来战略优势。为了研究这种现象，我们引入了一个基于两个战略性多智能体环境的实证框架：Liar's Bar（一种竞争性欺骗场景）和 Cleanup（一种混合动机资源管理场景），其中为智能体提供了秘密共谋工具，这些工具提供了显着的优势，同时明显对其他智能体不利。在 12 个模型（7B、70B 和专有规模）和 6 个提示变体中，我们发现大多数智能体一致接受这些工具并制定共谋策略，同时明确...
abstract_en: Even when a tool is explicitly described as unfair and harmful to others, ostensibly safety-aligned LLM agents still voluntarily engage in secret collusion whenever doing so confers a strategic advantage. To investigate this phenomenon, we introduce an empirical framework built on two strategic multi-agent environments: Liar's Bar, a competitive deception scenario, and Cleanup, a mixed-motive resource-management scenario, in which agents are offered secret collusion tools that provide significant advantages while clearly disadvantaging the other agents. Across 12 models (at the 7B, 70B, and proprietary scales) and 6 prompt variants, we find that most agents consistently accept these tools and develop collusive strategies, while explicitly acknowledging the unfairness of the tools before accepting. We further show that neither the unfairness labels nor baseline alignment alone reliably deters collusion: only explicit ethical framing reduces adoption and, even then, smaller models remain susceptible. More broadly, our work presents the first systematic investigation of voluntary collusion adoption in LLM-based multi-agent systems, and suggests that preventing such behaviour requires explicit safeguards rather than reliance on general alignment.

abstract_zh: 分层多标签文本分类（HMTC）要求模型能够捕获标签之间的结构依赖关系以及不同层次上标签的细粒度语义。现有方法通常通过预测约束或单个标签和局部关系的表示来对层次结构进行建模。然而，结构监督和语义监督通常是分开制定的。相反，我们使用完整的根到节点标签路径作为两者的共享单元。我们的框架引入了两个辅助训练目标，同时在推理时保留标准的多标签分类器。 PathSimNCE 使用层次结构感知对比目标将文档表示与层次结构路径对齐。这些目标提供分级监督...
abstract_en: Hierarchical multi-label text classification (HMTC) requires models to capture both structural dependencies among labels and the fine-grained semantics of labels at different hierarchy levels. Existing methods often model hierarchy through prediction constraints or representations of individual labels and local relations. Structural and semantic supervision, however, are usually formulated separately. We instead use complete root-to-node label paths as a shared unit for both. Our framework introduces two auxiliary training objectives while retaining a standard multi-label classifier at inference. PathSimNCE aligns document representations with hierarchical paths using hierarchy-aware contrastive targets. These targets provide graded supervision for structurally related paths while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. The complementary semantic objective uses LLM-generated, document-conditioned descriptions of the same positive paths. It thereby provides context-specific label semantics beyond static label representations. Experiments on three benchmarks show consistent improvements: structural alignment is particularly beneficial in deeper hierarchies, while semantic alignment provides additional gains for fine-grained labels.

abstract_zh: 遗传学中面向患者的数字工具可以提高效率和个性化护理，但由于传统面对面接触相关的联系感减弱，可能会威胁到患者与提供者的关系。为了了解在提供遗传服务时使用数字工具的经验和偏好，对接受过临床或研究基因检测的患者或儿童的父母进行了半结构化访谈。纳入不需要直接使用数字医疗工具的经验。对数据进行了主题分析。来自加拿大各地的总共三十名参与者接受了采访。其中，17 人（57%）接受了自身基因检测，20 人（67%）被确定为女性。参加者...
abstract_en: Patient-facing digital tools in genetics can increase efficiency and personalize care, but may threaten patient-provider relationships due to a diminished sense of connection associated with traditional face-to-face encounters. To learn about experiences with and preferences for using digital tools in the delivery of genetic services, semi-structured interviews were conducted with patients or parents of children who had clinical or research genetic testing. Direct experience with a digital healthcare tool was not required for inclusion. Data were analyzed thematically. A total of thirty participants from across Canada were interviewed. Of these, 17 (57%) received genetic testing for themselves and 20 (67%) identified as female. Participants described previous positive experiences with digital tools in medical settings and welcomed the shift towards their increased use in genetics. Participants desired increased agency, access, and control while maintaining the human touch with their healthcare providers. They anticipated that supplementing care with a digital tool could provide the balance and personalization desired for digitally-enabled agency and better access to health information, including genetic test results. Digital tools can facilitate innovation in patient-centered care, enabling a personalized model of care that retains a sense of connection with healthcare providers.

abstract_zh: 背景：吞咽功能障碍和长期胃造口管依赖是口腔癌切除游离皮瓣重建后的常见并发症，凸显了术前风险预测的必要性。方法：我们对接受游离皮瓣重建的非转移性口腔癌患者进行了一项多中心回顾性汇总队列研究。 Firth 的惩罚逻辑回归、LASSO 和随机森林模型使用 10 倍交叉验证进行训练，并通过接受者操作曲线下面积 (AUC) 评估预测性能。结果：500 名患者（平均年龄 61.7 岁）中，78 名患者（16%）在 12 个月时依赖胃造口管。随机森林模型在预测 12-... 方面最为准确
abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Swallowing dysfunction and long-term gastrostomy tube dependence are common morbidities after oral cavity cancer resection with free flap reconstruction, highlighting the need for preoperative risk prediction. METHODS: We performed a multicenter retrospective pooled cohort study of patients with non-metastatic oral cavity cancer undergoing free flap reconstruction. Firth's penalized logistic regression, LASSO, and random forest models were trained using 10-fold cross-validation and predictive performance was assessed via area under the receiver operator curve (AUC). RESULTS: Among 500 patients (mean age 61.7 years), 78 (16%) were gastrostomy tube dependent at 12 months. The random forest model was most accurate in predicting 12-month gastrostomy tube dependency (AUC; 0.77), with comparable performance from LASSO (AUC; 0.71) and Firth's penalized logistic regression (AUC; 0.70). Key predictors included TNM stage IV, T4 disease, unilateral neck dissection, reconstruction site, and no tongue resection. CONCLUSIONS: The three models predicted 12-month gastrostomy tube dependency after oral cavity free-flap surgery with fair accuracy and novel predictors; larger multicenter datasets may further improve predictive performance.

title_zh: 具有有限样本保证的特定分布曲率控制，可保证空载安全
title_en: Distribution-Specific Curvature Control with Finite-Sample Guarantees for Open-Weight Safety
authors: Subhabrata Majumdar；Domenic Rosati；Ali Dadsetan；Frank Rudzicz；Hassan Chowdhry；Hassan Sajjad；Hong Huang；Xijie Zeng
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 短暂的微调运行可以消除开放权重模型的安全防护——重新训练经过拒绝训练的助手来帮助武器开发或产生仇恨言论。在保持良性适应性的同时防止这种有害的微调仍然很困难：唯一具有明确曲率证书的现有方法，光谱变形，全局曲率膨胀，从而阻碍良性适应和有害适应。我们提出了 HarmAlign，它沿着估计的对比激活子空间应用保留功能的谱变形。我们推导了估计子空间能量的有限样本界限以及由此产生的局部有害分布曲率下界。持续发展的稳定性与进步二分法...
abstract_en: A short fine-tuning run can undo the safety guards of an open-weight model---retraining a refusal-trained assistant to aid weapons development or produce hate speech. Preventing such harmful fine-tuning while retaining benign adaptability remains difficult: the only prior method with an explicit curvature certificate, spectral deformation, inflates curvature globally and thereby obstructs benign adaptation along with harmful adaptation. We propose HarmAlign, which applies function-preserving spectral deformation along a estimated contrastive activation subspace. We derive finite-sample bounds for the estimated subspace energy and the resulting local harmful-distribution curvature lower bound. A stability--progress dichotomy for constant-step gradient descent turns the certified curvature into conditional convergence-rate control. Empirically, within a fixed-architecture, finite-budget first-order threat model, HarmAlign blocks direct fine-tuning and three data- or objective-adaptive attacks across a hazardous-knowledge relearning setting and a harmful-assistance fine-tuning setting, while the protected benign tasks remain trainable. The block persists across the tested first-order optimizer variants over every attack checkpoint, and under out-of-distribution harmful fine-tuning, and it extends to important cases in our threat model: accidental safety degradation and emergent misalignment.

title_zh: 开放重量安全的收敛率控制的限制
title_en: Limits of Convergence-Rate Control for Open-Weight Safety
authors: Domenic Rosati；Subhabrata Majumdar；Frank Rudzicz；Xijie Zeng；Hassan Sajjad；Hong Huang；Sebastian Dionicio
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 开放重量基础模型在发布后可能会出于有害目的进行微调，但现有的训练阻力方法还没有提供理论保证。将这些干预视为收敛速度控制问题使我们能够将优化速度与模型权重的谱结构联系起来。我们利用这一见解，通过谱重新参数化对收敛速度控制有了新的理解，并推导出一种算法 SpecDef，该算法可以在非对抗性设置中通过证明和经验来减慢一阶和二阶优化。在对抗性环境中，我们对包括我们自己的在内的一系列收敛速度控制方法建立了基本限制：拥有足够知识的攻击者可以...
abstract_en: Open-weight foundation models can be fine-tuned for harmful purposes after release, yet no existing training resistance methods provide theoretical guarantees. Treating these interventions as convergence-rate control problems allows us to connect optimization speed to the spectral structure of model weights. We leverage this insight to develop a novel understanding of convergence rate control through spectral reparameterization and derive an algorithm, SpecDef, that can both provably and empirically slow first- and second-order optimization in non-adversarial settings. In adversarial settings, we establish a fundamental limit on a broad class of convergence rate control methods including our own: an attacker with sufficient knowledge can restore fast convergence at a linear increase in model size. In order to overcome this limitation, future works will need to investigate methods that are not equivalent to controlling convergence rate.

title_zh: 理解和衡量大语言模型行为中的认知萎缩
title_en: Towards Understanding and Measuring COGNITIVE ATROPHY in LLM Behaviour
authors: Elham Dolatabadi；Laleh Seyyed-Kalantari；Frank Rudzicz；R. Shayna Rosenbaum；Negin Baghbanzadeh；Sara Pishdadian；Moyosoreoluwa Olatosi；Abeer Badawi
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 情感大模型；多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 最近涉及用于心理健康支持的大语言模型的事件揭示了一个关键的评估差距：表面水平的安全评分并不能反映模型随着时间的推移在现实、情感敏感的互动中的表现。现有的基准衡量知识、安全性或静态响应质量，但忽略了 LLM 交互是否有助于用户不断反思、应对和自行决策。我们将这个缺失的维度正式化为认知萎缩，这是人工智能介导的心理健康支持中的一种过程级行为测量，与安全性和帮助性不同。为了衡量这一点，我们引入了认知萎缩基准，这是一个基于临床的基准，由 1,576 次完全由人类生成的咨询对话、15,680 次轮流和 42,230 条回复构建而成。
abstract_en: Recent incidents involving LLMs used for mental-health support reveal a critical evaluation gap: surface-level safety scores do not capture how models behave across realistic, emotionally sensitive interactions over time. Existing benchmarks measure knowledge, safety, or static response quality, but miss whether LLM interactions help users keep reflecting, coping, and making decisions themselves. We formalize this missing dimension as COGNITIVE ATROPHY, a process-level behavioural measure in AI-mediated mental-health support distinct from safety and helpfulness. To measure it, we introduce COGNITIVE ATROPHY BENCH, a clinically grounded benchmark built from 1,576 fully human-generated counseling conversations, 15,680 turns, and 42,230 responses from five LLMs. Three clinical and neuropsychology experts developed a 20-attribute schema spanning user context, response behaviour, and global risk flags; six trained clinical reviewers applied it with span-grounded evidence, producing 5,324 reviewer judgments. We further introduce the User-Input Risk Index (UIRI), the Cognitive Atrophy Risk Index (ARI), and trajectory summaries. Across five LLMs, models show a consistent moderate-to-high level of atrophy-aligned behaviour across single and multi-turn settings. While models generally respond to overt safety cues, they adapt less reliably when users seek solutions or decisions. The dominant recurring patterns are directive advice, problem-solving, recommendation responses, topic shifts, and forms of validation that may reinforce dependence rather than reflection. Our work makes COGNITIVE ATROPHY measurable and provides a foundation for auditing model behaviour in sensitive LLM conversations.

title_zh: 利用大型语言模型进行个性化和上下文感知的说服性健康干预措施：压力管理案例研究
title_en: Leveraging Large Language Models for Personalized and Context-Aware Persuasive Health Interventions: A Stress Management Case Study
authors: Grace Ataguba；Fidelia A. Orji；Rita Orji；Frank Rudzicz
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 有说服力的技术有望通过个性化的数字干预措施促进健康行为。然而，开发能够动态适应用户不断变化的环境和动机状态的干预措施仍然是一个关键挑战。在这项研究中，我们对两个大型语言模型（LLM）进行了微调，并评估了它们生成个性化、情境感知的压力管理建议的能力，这些建议基于四种说服策略：自我监控、承诺和一致性、社会比较和竞争。我们通过自动、定量和定性指标评估生成的建议，以评估其相关性和上下文一致性。领域专家独立评估建议并提供...
abstract_en: Persuasive technologies hold significant promise for promoting healthy behaviours through personalized digital interventions. Yet developing interventions that dynamically adapt to users' evolving contexts and motivational states remains a key challenge. In this study, we fine-tuned two large language models (LLMs) and evaluated their ability to generate personalized, context-aware stress management recommendations grounded in four persuasive strategies: self-monitoring, commitment & consistency, social comparison, and competition. We evaluated generated recommendations through automatic, quantitative, and qualitative metrics to assess their relevance and contextual alignment. Domain experts independently rated the recommendations and provided structured feedback, which we analyzed thematically to identify key strengths and limitations. Results demonstrate that fine-tuned LLMs have the potential to generate persuasive, contextually aligned health recommendations tailored to individual users' stress profiles and preferred persuasive strategies. These findings advance the design of AI-powered adaptive health systems and offer actionable insights for building persuasive digital interventions that dynamically respond to users' motivational profiles and behavioural contexts.

authors: Joana Amorim；Frank Rudzicz；João Pimentel
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 尽管说话人分类已经变得更加强大和更加精细，包括融入现代自动语音识别 (ASR)，但当前系统仍然受到一些破坏性因素的影响，例如噪声。我们全面评估当前分类系统的局限性，以揭示阻碍准确性的根本原因。五个开源二值化管道（仅二值化系统以及联合 ASR 和二值化系统）在一组异构基准数据集上进行了评估。我们将联合管道的性能与仅二值化系统的性能进行比较，并分析哪些音频特征阻碍说话者辨别，以及使用说话者计数作为输入参数的影响。我们的结果...
abstract_en: Although speaker diarization has evolved to be more robust and more refined, including incorporating modern automatic speech recognition (ASR), current systems still suffer from several disruptive factors, like noise. We comprehensively evaluate the limitations of current diarization systems to uncover the underlying causes that hinder accuracy. Five open‐source diarization pipelines—both diarization‐only and joint ASR and diarization systems—are assessed on a set of heterogeneous benchmark data sets. We compare the performance of joint pipelines against those of diarization‐only systems, and analyse which audio characteristics hinder speaker discrimination, as well as the impact of using the speaker count as an input parameter. Our results indicate that diarization‐only and joint approaches are competitive with each other in unsupervised scenarios, and that providing the speaker count does not improve performance consistently. We also identify short audio duration and low speech‐to‐noise ratio (SNR) as the most impairing properties. We recommend using speech representation learning to further uncover underlying factors that affect diarization, pre‐processing techniques to remove noise, and performing hyper‐parameter tuning on, for example, the speech window length, and speech detection thresholds.

title_zh: 面向人工智能驱动的临床决策支持的自适应智能仪表板
title_en: Towards an Adaptive and Intelligent Dashboard for AI-Driven Clinical Decision Support
authors: Rita Orji；Grace Ataguba；Fidelia A. Orji；Frank Rudzicz；Arafat Motolani
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 临床人工智能仪表板可以支持风险预测、患者优先顺序和临床医生的决策。然而，将此类系统从原型转向临床使用需要的不仅仅是准确的预测。仪表板应支持自适应配置、指南治理、信任感知推荐交付、隐私控制和人机交互反馈。本文提出了一种用于混合机器学习和大型语言模型临床人工智能仪表板的自适应架构，用于低氧血症和高血压风险预测。使用设计科学方法，我们将临床医生的担忧和部署要求转化为自适应智能系统功能，并通过三层架构将其付诸实践：一个项目...
abstract_en: Clinical AI dashboards can support risk prediction, patient prioritization, and clinicians' decision-making. However, moving such systems from prototype to clinical use requires more than accurate predictions. The dashboards should support adaptive configuration, guideline governance, confidence-aware recommendation delivery, privacy control, and human-in-the-loop feedback. This paper presents an adaptive architecture for a hybrid machine learning and large language model clinical AI dashboard for hypoxemia and hypertension risk prediction. Using a design-science approach, we translated clinicians' concerns and deployment requirements into adaptive intelligent-system features and operationalized them through a three-layer architecture: a predictive intelligence layer, an explanation and recommendation layer, and an adaptive control layer. The adaptive control layer governs how AI recommendations are configured, displayed, justified, filtered, and refined through clinician interaction. We instantiate the architecture through a dashboard prototype and a feedback-to-requirement mapping that shows how clinicians' concerns were translated into system mechanisms for guideline-source configuration, explanation personalization, confidence-threshold adjustment, privacy and security control, and structured accept/modify/override feedback. This work contributes a clinician-informed adaptive architecture for AI clinical decision support and demonstrates how dashboard-level intelligence can support localized guideline alignment, transparent recommendation delivery, clinician oversight, and continuous system refinement for safer clinical AI adoption.

title_zh: 内部总结评估：了解人类和 GPT 判断以改进基于 LLM 的评估
title_en: Inside summary evaluation: Understanding human and GPT judgments to improve LLM-based evaluation
authors: Zahra Sadeghi；Frank Rudzicz；Evangelos E. Milios
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已成为文本摘要的有效评估器，通常与人类的判断达成强烈一致。然而，人类和大语言模型评估决策背后的机制仍然知之甚少，限制了基于大语言模型评估的透明度和可信度。现有的研究主要集中于衡量人类和大语言模型分数之间的一致性，提供有关驱动这些判断的可观察评估信号的有限信息。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个可解释的框架，通过识别和比较与人类和生成相关的语言、基于嵌入和信息理论的评估信号来系统地理解总结评估。
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as effective evaluators of text summaries, often achieving strong agreement with human judgments. However, the mechanisms underlying both human and LLM evaluation decisions remain poorly understood, limiting the transparency and trustworthiness of LLM-based evaluation. Existing studies primarily focus on measuring agreement between human and LLM scores, providing limited information on the observable evaluation signals that drive these judgments. In this work, we present an explainable framework for systematically understanding summary evaluation by identifying and comparing the linguistic, embedding-based, and information-theoretic evaluation signals signals associated with both human and Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPT) judgments. We also formulate a context-aware conditional perplexity metric that incorporates the source document into the evaluation process. Through comprehensive correlation analysis across the relevance and coherence evaluation dimensions, we show that conditional perplexity exhibits the strongest association with both human and GPT judgments, while embedding-based similarity is more strongly associated with relevance than coherence. Building on these findings, we demonstrate that incorporating the identified human-aligned evaluation signals into GPT prompts improves agreement with human judgments without requiring additional model training or fine-tuning. In sum, our work bridges the gap between interpretable evaluation signals and LLM-based judgment, providing a step toward a more transparent, explainable, and human-aligned summary evaluation.

title_zh: 培训治疗法官和多智能体系统以提供人性化的心理健康支持
title_en: Training Therapeutic Judges and Multi-Agent Systems for Human-Aligned Mental Health Support
authors: Elham Dolatabadi；Laleh Seyyed-Kalantari；Mizanur Rahman；Frank Rudzicz；Enamul Hoque Prince；Elahe Rahimi；Abeer Badawi
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 情感智能；强化学习与决策优化
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型显示出支持心理健康的希望，但只有当评估作为可操作的控制信号而不是被动的指标时，治疗质量才能提高。我们引入了一个框架，该框架将治疗反应的生成制定为由多维、人性化评估驱动的决策细化问题。在第一阶段，我们引入了 TheraJudge，这是一种开源治疗评估器，通过对人类注释数据进行基于偏好的优化进行训练，以在 7 个心理维度上产生可靠的判断。在第二阶段，我们引入了 TheraAgent，它通过与专门的评论家、教练和治疗师角色协调一致的细化流程来操作 TheraJudge 的评估，这些角色将评估结果转化为……
abstract_en: Large language models show promise for mental health support, yet therapeutic quality improves only when evaluation functions as an actionable control signal rather than a passive metric. We introduce a framework that formulates therapeutic response generation as a decision-refinement problem driven by multi-dimensional, human-aligned evaluation. In Stage I, we introduce TheraJudge, an open-source therapeutic evaluator trained via preference-based optimization on human-annotated data to produce reliable judgments across 7 psychological dimensions. In Stage II, we introduce TheraAgent, which operationalizes TheraJudge's evaluations through a coordinated refinement process with specialized Critic, Coach, and Therapist roles that translate evaluative signals into targeted response revisions. Empirically, TheraJudge achieves strong agreement with clinician ratings, with intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC = 0.87-0.95), surpassing supervised baselines and strong closed-source judges, particularly on critical dimensions such as Safety, Relevance, and Empathy. Acting on these evaluations, TheraAgent yields a +0.43 improvement in human-rated therapeutic quality (on a 5-point scale) under blind evaluation, with 96\% clinician inter-rater reliability. Low-quality responses ($\leq 3$) improve by +2.45 points with a 94\% recovery rate, demonstrating targeted correction of unsafe outputs. Overall, our results indicate that effective alignment of mental-health LLMs stems from acting on human-aligned evaluation, rather than relying solely on stronger generation. We release code at https://github.com/vis-nlp/TheraAlign.

title_zh: 删除信息内容并不能证明开放重量模型的防篡改能力
title_en: Removing Information Content Does Not Certify Tamper Resistance in Open-Weight Models
authors: Subhabrata Majumdar；Domenic Rosati；Ali Dadsetan；Matthew Young；Alessa Carbo；Hassan Sajjad；Frank Rudzicz；Hong Huang
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 删除有害信息是否可以使开放权重模型抵抗微调攻击？我们表明，仅发布时的共同信息并不能普遍证明恢复缓慢。保留功能的重新参数化在改变梯度下降几何形状时保持信息不变，因此不变证书受到最快可达参数化的限制。我们将这一原理应用于训练数据过滤下的权重数据互信息和能力去除下的标签表示互信息。训练顺序可以改变固定权重数据信息的恢复时间，而精确的表示级独立性可以保留整个参数雅可比行列式。显式构造具有信息量...
abstract_en: Does removing harmful information make open-weight models resistant to fine-tuning attacks? We show that mutual information at release alone cannot universally certify slow recovery. Function-preserving reparameterizations leave information unchanged while altering gradient-descent geometry, so an invariant certificate is bounded by the fastest reachable parameterization. We apply this principle to weight--data mutual information under training-data filtering and label--representation mutual information under capability removal. Training order can change recovery time at fixed weight--data information, while exact representation-level independence can preserve the entire parameter Jacobian. An explicit construction has both information quantities equal to zero and recovers in one gradient step. Controlled experiments illustrate order-dependent recovery and parameterization-dependent attack speed. These results identify the missing requirement for certification: constraints on attack dynamics beyond mutual information at release.

title_zh: 设计人工智能辅助语音交互系统，用于儿童家庭句子练习
title_en: Designing an AI-Assisted Speech-Based Interactive System for Home-Based Sentence Practice for Children
authors: Elizabeth Wiafe；Frank Rudzicz；Lizbeth Escobedo
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 表达性句子结构是儿童学业发展的基础，但在临床环境之外进行结构化练习和接收反馈的机会仍然有限。这篇正在进行中的论文提出了一种人工智能辅助的基于语音的交互式原型，旨在通过多模式提示和自动反馈来支持基于家庭的句子制定。该系统集成了视觉刺激、引导目标词、本地语音识别和结构化语法感知分析，通过联合决策规则评估句子完整性、目标词使用、复杂性水平和上下文相关性，以提供支持性、非诊断性反馈。我们描述了系统架构并概述了提议的...
abstract_en: Expressive sentence construction is foundational to children’s academic development, yet opportunities for structured practice and receiving feedback outside clinical environments remain limited. This work-in-progress paper presents an AI-assisted speech-based interactive prototype designed to support home-based sentence formulation through multimodal prompts and automated feedback. The system integrates visual stimuli, guided target words, local speech recognition, and structured grammar-aware analysis that evaluates sentence completeness, target word use, complexity level, and contextual relevance through a conjunctive decision rule to provide supportive, non-diagnostic feedback. We describe the system architecture and outline a proposed pilot study with children aged 6-12, complemented by expert input from speech-language pathologists, to evaluate feasibility, usability, and perceived educational value.

title_zh: 使用多目标强化学习优化帕金森病药物剂量
title_en: Parkinson's Disease Drug Dose Optimization Using Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
authors: Ahmad Rezaie Mianroodi；Seyed‐Mohammad Fereshtehnejad；Frank Rudzicz
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 强化学习与决策优化；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 帕金森病 (PD) 药物管理需要平衡运动症状控制与运动障碍等不良反应，从而做出多维度且偏好敏感的治疗决策。医疗保健领域的大多数强化学习 (RL) 方法都会优化单个标量目标，这需要提前确定结果优先级，并且可能会掩盖目标之间的权衡。我们将帕金森病药物剂量调整制定为多目标马尔可夫决策过程，并将多目标强化学习应用于帕金森病进展标记计划的纵向数据。该框架联合模拟运动严重程度和运动障碍相关目标，并估计代表不同传统的帕累托政策集。
abstract_en: Parkinson's disease (PD) medication management requires balancing motor symptom control against adverse effects such as dyskinesia, making treatment decisions multi-dimensional and preference-sensitive. Most reinforcement learning (RL) approaches in healthcare optimize a single scalar objective, which requires outcome priorities to be fixed in advance and can obscure trade-offs among objectives. We formulate PD medication dose adjustment as a multi-objective Markov Decision Process and apply multi-objective reinforcement learning to longitudinal data from Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative. The framework jointly models motor severity and dyskinesia-related objectives and estimates a Pareto set of policies representing different trade-offs between them. Across 500 patient-level resamples, Pareto-optimal AI policies were assigned higher estimated motor-objective values than clinician and random baselines under the offline evaluation procedure, while estimated dyskinesia-objective values varied across preference weightings. Recommended levodopa equivalent daily dose adjustments also differed across the Pareto frontier, suggesting that changes in objective weighting can alter learned dose-adjustment behavior. By separating estimated outcome trade-offs from value prioritization, this approach provides a framework for studying preference-sensitive sequential treatment decisions in chronic neurological care. More broadly, the results suggest that multi-objective reinforcement learning may help make treatment trade-offs more explicit, supporting future work toward transparent and patient-centered decision-support tools for Parkinson's disease.

title_zh: 使用语音开发孕期重度抑郁症和广泛性焦虑症的多变量预测模型
title_en: Using Speech to Develop Multivariable Prediction Models for Major Depressive Disorder and Generalized Anxiety Disorder During Pregnancy
authors: Hamideh Bayrampour；Joana Amorim；João Pimentel；Sukhpreet K. Tamana；Patricia Janssen；Alixandra Bacon；Frank Rudzicz
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 抑郁和焦虑在怀孕期间很常见，但仍未被发现。在这个项目中，我们研究了言语对于预测怀孕期间重度抑郁症（MDD）和广泛性焦虑症（GAD）的有用性。 。我们从包含患者和采访者声音的录音访谈（完整访谈）以及手动验证的患者语音片段（VS）中提取语音特征。我们训练了几种机器学习模型，并在多变量分析中将基于语音的模型的预测性能与由怀孕/社会人口特征和语音特征组成的组合模型进行了比较。总样本包括 146 名参与者：19 名患有 MDD，28 名患有 GAD（3 名患有其他疾病）
abstract_en: Depression and anxiety are common during pregnancy yet remain underdetected. In this project, we examined the usefulness of speech for predicting major depressive disorder (MDD) and generalized anxiety disorder (GAD) during pregnancy. . We extracted speech features from recorded interviews that contained the voices of both patient and the interviewer (full interview), as well as from manually verified speech segments (VS) of patients. We trained several machine learning models and compared the predictive performance of speech-based models with combined models-consisting of pregnancy/sociodemographic characteristics and speech features-in multivariate analyses. The total sample included 146 participants: 19 with MDD, 28 with GAD (3 had comorbid MDD and GAD), and 102 controls (no current/past known psychiatric disorders). Speech models based on the full interviews showed consistent patterns of good performance for MDD (F1-scores between 74%-77%) and GAD (F1-scores between 76%-80%). Models based on VS showed poor performance for MDD (F1-scores between 42%-45%) and acceptable performance for GAD (F1-scores between 51%-65%). Adding pregnancy/sociodemographic characteristics to the best speech models did not improve the performance of GAD models (best F1-score 78.00%±19.86) and slightly reduced that of MDD models (best F1-score 76.00%±11.45). The most influential speech features for prediction of MDD and GAD during pregnancy aligned with those reported among the general population.

title_zh: 通过多属性人类评估评估大语言模型响应中心理健康支持的质量
title_en: Assessing the Quality of Mental Health Support in LLM Responses through Multi-Attribute Human Evaluation
authors: Elham Dolatabadi；Frank Rudzicz；Md. Tahmid Rahman Laskar；Lames Danok；Jimmy Huang；Sheri Grach；Abeer Badawi；Lindsay Bertrand；Elahe Rahimi
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 情感大模型；情感智能；多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 全球心理健康危机不断升级，其特点是持续存在的治疗差距、可用性和合格治疗师的短缺，使大语言模型 (LLM) 成为提供可扩展支持的有前途的途径。虽然大语言模型提供了易于获得的情感援助的潜力，但其可靠性、治疗相关性以及与人类标准的一致性仍然难以解决。本文介绍了一种以人为本的评估方法，旨在评估大语言模型在治疗对话中产生的反应。我们的方法包括从包含现实世界场景问题的数据集中整理 500 个心理健康对话的数据集，并评估九个不同的大语言模型生成的回答，包括闭源和开源模式......
abstract_en: The escalating global mental health crisis, marked by persistent treatment gaps, availability, and a shortage of qualified therapists, positions Large Language Models (LLMs) as a promising avenue for scalable support. While LLMs offer potential for accessible emotional assistance, their reliability, therapeutic relevance, and alignment with human standards remain challenging to address. This paper introduces a human-grounded evaluation methodology designed to assess LLM generated responses in therapeutic dialogue. Our approach involved curating a dataset of 500 mental health conversations from datasets with real-world scenario questions and evaluating the responses generated by nine diverse LLMs, including closed source and open source models. More specifically, these responses were evaluated by two psychiatric trained experts, who independently rated each on a 5 point Likert scale across a comprehensive 6 attribute rubric. This rubric captures Cognitive Support and Affective Resonance, providing a multidimensional perspective on therapeutic quality. Our analysis reveals that LLMs provide strong cognitive reliability by producing safe, coherent, and clinically appropriate information, but they demonstrate unstable affective alignment. Although closed source models (e.g., GPT-4o) offer balanced therapeutic responses, open source models show greater variability and emotional flatness. We reveal a persistent cognitive-affective gap and highlight the need for failure aware, clinically grounded evaluation frameworks that prioritize relational sensitivity alongside informational accuracy in mental health oriented LLMs. We advocate for balanced evaluation protocols with human in the loop that center on therapeutic sensitivity and provide a framework to guide the responsible design and clinical oversight of mental health oriented conversational AI.

title_zh: 我们什么时候可以信任心理健康领域的大语言模型？可靠的大语言模型评估的大规模基准
title_en: When Can We Trust LLMs in Mental Health? Large-Scale Benchmarks for Reliable LLM Evaluation
authors: Elham Dolatabadi；Frank Rudzicz；Md. Tahmid Rahman Laskar；Elahe Rahimi；Jimmy Huang；Abeer Badawi；Prathiba Dhanesh；Sheri Grach；Lames Danok；Lindsay Bertrand
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 情感大模型；情感智能；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 由于治疗对话在情感和认知上的复杂性，评估用于心理健康支持的大型语言模型（LLM）对可靠评估提出了独特的挑战。现有基准在规模、真实性和可靠性方面受到限制，通常依赖于合成数据或社交媒体数据，并且缺乏评估自动化法官何时可信的框架。为了满足大规模真实对话数据集和法官可靠性评估的需求，我们引入了两个基准，为该领域的生成和评估提供了框架。 MentalBench-100k 整合了来自三个真实场景数据集的 10,000 个真实的单次治疗对话，每个对话都与 9 个 LLM 生成的响应配对...
abstract_en: Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) for mental health support poses unique challenges to reliable evaluation due to the emotionally and cognitively complex nature of therapeutic dialogue. Existing benchmarks are limited in scale, authenticity, and reliability, often relying on synthetic or social media data, and lack frameworks to assess when automated judges can be trusted. To address the need for large-scale authentic dialogue datasets and judge-reliability assessment, we introduce two benchmarks that provide a framework for generation and evaluation in this domain. MentalBench-100k consolidates 10,000 authentic single-session therapeutic conversations from three real-world scenarios datasets, each paired with nine LLM-generated responses, yielding 100,000 response pairs. MentalAlign-70k reframes evaluation by comparing four high-performing LLM judges with human experts across 70,000 ratings on seven attributes, grouped into Cognitive Support Score (CSS) and Affective Resonance Score (ARS). We then employ the AffectiveвЂ“Cognitive Agreement Framework, a statistical methodology using intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC) with confidence intervals to quantify agreement, consistency, and bias between LLM judges and human experts. Our analysis reveals systematic inflation by LLM judges, strong reliability for cognitive attributes such as guidance and informativeness, reduced precision for empathy, and some unreliability in safety and relevance. Our contributions establish new methodological and empirical foundations for the reliable and large-scale evaluation of LLMs in mental health contexts.

title_zh: 寻求 SOTA：时间序列预测必须采用特定于分类的评估来消除虚幻的收益
title_en: Seeking SOTA: Time-Series Forecasting Must Adopt Taxonomy-Specific Evaluation to Dispel Illusory Gains
authors: Blanka Horvath；Raeid Saqur；Christoph Bergmeir；Daniel Schmidt；Terry Lyons；Frank Rudzicz
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 我们认为，目前评估人工智能/机器学习时间序列预测模型的做法主要基于具有强、持续周期性和季节性特征的基准，忽视了高效经典方法的性能，从而掩盖了真正的进展。我们证明，这些“标准”数据集通常表现出占主导地位的自相关模式和季节周期，可以通过更简单的线性或统计模型有效捕获这些模式，使复杂的深度学习架构在这些特定数据特征上通常不比经典对应架构具有更高的性能，并提出了这样的问题：任何边际改进是否证明计算开销和模型复杂性的显着增加是合理的……
abstract_en: We argue that the current practice of evaluating AI/ML time-series forecasting models, predominantly on benchmarks characterized by strong, persistent periodicities and seasonalities, obscures real progress by overlooking the performance of efficient classical methods. We demonstrate that these "standard" datasets often exhibit dominant autocorrelation patterns and seasonal cycles that can be effectively captured by simpler linear or statistical models, rendering complex deep learning architectures frequently no more performant than their classical counterparts for these specific data characteristics, and raising questions as to whether any marginal improvements justify the significant increase in computational overhead and model complexity. We call on the community to (I) retire or substantially augment current benchmarks with datasets exhibiting a wider spectrum of non-stationarities, such as structural breaks, time-varying volatility, and concept drift, and less predictable dynamics drawn from diverse real-world domains, and (II) require every deep learning submission to include robust classical and simple baselines, appropriately chosen for the specific characteristics of the downstream tasks' time series. By doing so, we will help ensure that reported gains reflect genuine scientific methodological advances rather than artifacts of benchmark selection favoring models adept at learning repetitive patterns.

title_zh: 用于动态风险评估和结果优化的人工智能（AIRO）：心脏外科机器学习的治理驱动框架（预印本）

abstract_zh: 背景技术当代心脏手术风险评估主要基于静态回归模型，该模型没有考虑不断变化的围手术期数据或临床工作流程中的整合。尽管机器学习方法提高了建模复杂关系的能力，但大多数现有应用程序仍然是回顾性的、特定于结果的，并且与现实世界的临床实施脱节。目的 描述动态风险评估和结果优化人工智能 (AIRO) 平台的开发，这是一个临床医生主导、治理驱动的框架，旨在支持整个围手术期的动态、可解释的风险评估和临床决策支持。方法 AIRO 是开发...
abstract_en: BACKGROUND Contemporary cardiac surgical risk assessment is largely based on static regression-derived models that do not account for evolving perioperative data or integration within clinical workflows. Although machine learning approaches offer improved capacity to model complex relationships, most existing applications remain retrospective, outcome-specific, and disconnected from real-world clinical implementation. OBJECTIVE To describe the development of the Artificial Intelligence for dynamic Risk assessment and Outcome optimization (AIRO) platform, a clinician-led, governance-driven framework designed to support dynamic, explainable risk assessment and clinical decision support across the perioperative continuum. METHODS AIRO was developed using a formative research approach integrating retrospective model development with prospective implementation design within a learning health system framework. Baseline predictive modelling (AIRO 1.0) was conducted using a prospectively maintained cardiac surgery registry comprising approximately 30,000 patients and over 13 million data elements. A standardized modelling pipeline was established to support development of multiple outcome-specific models. The AIRO conceptual framework was structured around three layers: population-level risk stratification, individual-level risk explanation, and dynamic outcome optimization. For clinical deployment (AIRO 2.0), a system architecture was designed to enable real-time model inference within the electronic health record using interoperable data standards (FHIR), supported by a dedicated integration layer and governance framework. An implementation and evaluation strategy was defined to assess feasibility, usability, and clinician adoption. RESULTS The AIRO platform was developed as an integrated system combining standardized model development, a three-layer conceptual framework, and a scalable architecture for electronic health record integration. Baseline models have been developed for multiple clinically relevant outcomes, including surgical site infection, postoperative delirium, and discharge disposition. A workflow-integrated deployment strategy was defined, intended to enabling near–real-time risk estimation and delivery of explainable outputs within the clinical environment. Governance structures were established supporting data security, auditability, and model oversight. The platform is designed to support prospective deployment and evaluation within routine perioperative care. CONCLUSIONS AIRO represents a conceptual and implementation-focused approach to integrating explainable machine learning into perioperative clinical care. By combining standardized modelling, EHR-integrated deployment, and a governance-driven framework, the platform is designed to support clinically meaningful risk assessment and decision support across the care continuum. Further work is required to evaluate its impact on clinical practice, clinician adoption, and patient outcomes.

abstract_zh: 持续的健康监测可以支持早期识别潜在的健康风险和福祉，而不仅仅是基于临时诊所的护理。本文介绍了 VitalAnchor 的设计和以用户为中心的评估，VitalAnchor 是一款智能移动健康应用程序，集成了基于智能手表的生命体征监测、基于人工智能的异常生命体征模式检测、可解释的人工智能反馈以及有说服力的健康提示，以鼓励采取适当的后续行动。三十名成年人与应用程序原型进行交互，并使用系统可用性量表 (SUS) 评估其可用性。适应健康信念模型（HBM）还用于评估有关定期健康监测的特定行为参考的信念，参与者还提供了书面比率...
abstract_en: Continuous health monitoring can support early identification of potential health risks and well-being beyond episodic clinic-based care. This paper presents the design and user-centred evaluation of VitalAnchor, an intelligent mobile health app that integrates smartwatch-based vital sign monitoring, AI-based detection of abnormal vital sign patterns, explainable AI feedback, and persuasive health prompts to encourage appropriate follow-up actions. Thirty adults interacted with the app prototype and evaluated its usability using the System Usability Scale (SUS). Adapted Health Belief Model (HBM) was also used to assess beliefs concerning specific behavioural referent of regular health monitoring, and participants also provided written rationales and app-related comments. We analyzed quantitative data using descriptive and inferential statistics, and open-ended responses using thematic analysis. The results showed that the app achieved excellent usability, with a mean SUS score of 85.8. Perceived susceptibility, perceived severity, perceived benefits, cues to action, and self-efficacy were significantly above the neutral point, while perceived barriers to regular health monitoring were significantly below it. Thematic analysis identified themes concerning ease of use; understanding and transparency of AI explanations; perceived health utility; trust, accuracy, and self-efficacy; and design improvements. Participants valued plain-language interpretations and actionable recommendations but also raised concerns about possible misinterpretation and reliability of AI-generated warnings. The findings provide preliminary evidence that the prototype is highly usable and that participants perceive its monitoring and explanation features as potentially useful for supporting health awareness and timely action. We discuss the implications of these findings for the design of trustworthy, persuasive, explainable, and intelligent health systems.

title_zh: 这是LLM图书馆学习吗？评估必须考虑计算和行为
title_en: Is This LLM Library Learning? Evaluation Must Account For Compute and Behaviour
authors: Xujie Si；Frank Rudzicz；Ian Berlot-Attwell；Tobias Sesterhenn
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 大语言模型的情境学习（ICL）编码、推理和工具使用能力激发了人们对图书馆学习（即创建和利用可重用和可组合函数、工具或引理）的兴趣。此类系统通常承诺通过缓存推理（即存储生成的工具）来提高任务性能和计算效率 - 所有这些都无需微调。然而，我们有充分的理由对此表示怀疑。具体来说，我们发现大量 ICL 库学习工作中存在严重的评估缺陷：这些工作没有纠正基线和库学习系统之间计算成本的差异。研究了三个单独发布的 ICL 图书馆学习系统，我们发现它们都无法...
abstract_en: The in-context learning (ICL) coding, reasoning, and tool-using ability of LLMs has spurred interest in library learning (i.e., the creation and exploitation of reusable and composable functions, tools, or lemmas). Such systems often promise improved task performance and computational efficiency by caching reasoning (i.e., storing generated tools) - all without finetuning. However, we find strong reasons to be skeptical. Specifically, we identify a serious evaluation flaw present in a large number of ICL library learning works: these works do not correct for the difference in computational cost between baseline and library learning systems. Studying three separately published ICL library learning systems, we find that all of them fail to consistently outperform the simple baseline of prompting the model - improvements in task accuracy often vanish or reverse once computational cost is accounted for. Furthermore, we perform an in-depth examination of one such system, LEGO-Prover, which purports to learn reusable lemmas for mathematical reasoning. We find no evidence of the direct reuse of learned lemmas, and find evidence against the soft reuse of learned lemmas (i.e., reuse by modifying relevant examples). Our findings suggest that a serious re-examination of the effectiveness of ICL LLM-based library learning is required, as is much stronger standards for evaluation. An equal computational budget must be used for baselines, alongside behavioural analysis.

abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型（LLM）中的因果推理因将不同推理操作合并为总分的基准而变得复杂。我们提出了 CausalPrism，一个基于因果推理的结构因果模型语义和认知模型的评估框架，它将基于干预的因果推理分解为三个功能原语 - 因果先验、前向状态跟踪和信念更新 - 加上一致性原语，代理敏感性。原语在有向无环图中实例化，并在语义丰富度不同的三个叙述域中进行评估。在 14 个开源和前沿 LLM 中，信念更新是主要瓶颈：最好的模型仅达到 0.613 的准确度，而 GPT-...
abstract_en: Evaluating causal reasoning in large language models (LLMs) is complicated by benchmarks that conflate distinct reasoning operations into aggregate scores.We propose CausalPrism, an evaluation framework grounded in structural causal model semantics and cognitive models of causal inference, which decomposes intervention-based causal reasoning into three functional primitives-Causal Prior, Forward State Tracing, and Belief Updating-plus a consistency primitive, Agency Sensitivity.Primitives are instantiated in directed acyclic graphs and evaluated across three narrative domains of varying semantic richness.Across 14 opensource and frontier LLMs, Belief Updating is the dominant bottleneck: the best model reaches only 0.613 accuracy, while GPT-5.2 and GPT-5-mini score 0.531 and 0.517 despite near-ceiling performance on Causal Prior and Forward State Tracing.Prior exhibits systematic domain sensitivity and over-rejection.Agency framing effects are family-dependent for weaker models.We argue against treating causal reasoning as a unitary capability and motivate targeted evaluation and training along multiple primitive axes.

abstract_zh: 背景：痴呆症和心力衰竭（HF）经常同时存在；然而，这些条件之间的关系尚未得到充分探讨。目的：该研究的目的是：1）比较新诊断的心力衰竭患者或匹配的非心力衰竭对照者的痴呆发生率； 2) 检查心力衰竭患者痴呆诊断后的危险因素和结果。方法：在社区居民（40-80 岁）中，我们比较了新发心力衰竭患者的痴呆情况与年龄/性别以及心血管危险因素/疾病匹配的非心力衰竭对照。在心力衰竭患者中，我们检查了随时间变化的痴呆发作与死亡和住院结果的暴露情况。我们还比较了痴呆症诊断前后的医生就诊情况......
abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Dementia and heart failure (HF) frequently coexist; however, the relationship between these conditions is not fully explored. OBJECTIVES: The objectives of the study were to: 1) compare dementia incidence in newly-diagnosed patients with HF or matched non-HF controls; and 2) examine risk factors for and outcomes after dementia diagnosis in HF patients. METHODS: In community-dwelling residents (aged 40-80 years), we compared incident dementia in those with new-onset HF vs age/sex, and cardiovascular risk factor/disease-matched non-HF controls. First, we theoretically establish and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-token prediction (MTP), and show that the benefits of MTP are topologically agnostic. Second, we introduce alternative tokenizations and show that the two causes are orthogonal. Using these methods, we break through the scaling wall observed by prior work, consistently and stably learning to solve the task at scales far beyond previous limits.

abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly evaluated on multiple-choice tasks that ask them to select an answer or to abstain on unanswerable questions.Neither setting captures frame-breaking: where the question is answerable, but the correct answer lies outside the framing of a candidate set of invalid answers.A useful model must reframe the task, rather than choose an invalid frame-compliant answer.We introduce REFRAME, a test suite of 150 scenarios in which a commonsense constraint invalidates their framing.Each REFRAME scenario is additionally paired with a direct knowledge probe of the same frame-breaking constraint, which we leverage to separate what a model knows from what it deploys.Across nine frontier LLMs, we observe a substantial knowledge-deployment gap with zero-shot prompting.A targeted reasoning prompt only partially closes this gap.Human annotators, by contrast, readily detect the constraint and reframe the problem.Together, these results characterize frame-breaking as a distinct reasoning challenge and demonstrate significant room for LLM improvement.

abstract_zh: 尽管扩散模型取得了重大进展，但在没有特定任务训练的情况下实现精确且可组合的图像编辑仍然是一个挑战。现有的方法通常依赖于迭代优化或线性潜在操作，这些操作缓慢、脆弱，并且容易出现属性纠缠（例如，编辑“口红”无意中改变了肤色）。我们引入了 SphereEdit，这是一个免训练的框架，它利用扩散嵌入的球形几何和令牌感知交叉注意力来实现可解释的细粒度控制。我们将语义属性表示为去噪器预测空间中的单位向量方向，并表明对映对称性（“老”大约是“年轻”的否定）自然支持双向......
abstract_en: Despite significant advances in diffusion models, achieving precise and composable image editing without task-specific training remains a challenge. Existing approaches often rely on iterative optimization or linear latent operations, which are slow, brittle, and prone to attribute entanglement (e.g., editing "lipstick" inadvertently alters skin tone). We introduce SphereEdit, a training-free framework that leverages the spherical geometry of diffusion embeddings and token aware cross-attention to enable interpretable, fine-grained control. We represent semantic attributes as unit vector directions in the denoiser’s prediction space and show that antipodal symmetry (‘old’ is approximately the negation of ‘young’) naturally supports bidirectional edits, while approximate orthogonality enables clean composition through spherical coefficient. At inference, these directions modulate cross-attention activations, producing spatially localized edits without optimization or fine-tuning. SphereEdit achieves sharper, more disentangled edits than prior baselines, while remaining plug-and-play and applicable across diverse image editing tasks. abstract_en: Actigraphy is a non-invasive method for continuous monitoring of rest–activity cycles, sleep patterns, light exposure, body temperature and other physiological rhythms in real-world settings. By passively capturing behavioral data over extended periods, it enables detailed characterization of the temporal dynamics of biological rhythms and their relevance to physiology and health. As actigraphy becomes increasingly common in large-scale observational studies and clinical trials, the need for standardized procedures in data acquisition and processing has become urgent. Variability across devices, scoring algorithms, and analytic pipelines can hinder reproducibility and limit the integration of data across data collection sites. This report introduces standardized guidelines for the use of actigraphy in clinical research, supporting reproducibility, comparability and harmonization across studies. A fillable standardized operating procedure for actigraphy research, along with an empirical example, supports best practices across the full workflow, from device selection and data collection to quality control, analysis, and transparent reporting. By promoting clarity in documentation, harmonization of processing choices, and rigorous quality control, this work aims to enhance the reliability and reproducibility of actigraphy-derived variables as potential digital biomarkers and to support broader implementation of actigraphy in studies of health and disease.

abstract_en: Recent work characterizes the Adam optimizer as sign descent modulated by gradient uncertainty: the update is the sign of the batch gradient, scaled by how strongly the batch supports that sign. We apply this view directly and introduce ZEMA (Z-score Evidence Momentum Adaptation), which measures that support with a per-coordinate $z$-score computed from the per-example gradients in the current batch, converts it into a sign probability, and smooths the resulting update with a single exponential moving average. Because the probability is formed before smoothing rather than after, ZEMA keeps one state per parameter instead of Adam's two, at a $4.6$ increase in per-step time; the per-example variance it requires can also be estimated from a small fraction of the batch. In fine-tuning and pretraining experiments, ZEMA is competitive with Adam, reduces the variability of the validation loss, and in some settings recovers the sign of the full-dataset gradient more consistently. We close with two directions this opens: extending confidence adaptation beyond the sign geometry, to methods such as Muon, and to differentially private training.

authors: Michael Fralick；Stephanie Lee；Meggie Debnath；Derek Beaton；Jamie Fritz；Blair Jones；Vera Dounaevskaia；Yuna Lee；Michael Colacci；Orly Bogler；Frank Rudzicz；Muhammad Mamdani

abstract_zh: 背景住院患者有多种出血危险因素，包括危重疾病、介入手术、频繁静脉切开术以及使用抗凝剂和抗血小板药物。目前尚不清楚识别出血风险最高的住院患者的决策支持工具是否可以预防血红蛋白极低及其相关后遗症，例如需要输血。目的 创建一个决策支持工具来识别出血后遗症高风险（“高风险”）的住院患者，并评估该工具对血红蛋白极低和输血率的影响。方法我们对三级教学医院普通内科住院患者进行了队列研究。
abstract_en: Background Hospitalized patients have multiple risk factors for bleeding including critical illness, interventional procedures, frequent phlebotomy, and use of anticoagulant and antiplatelet medications. It is unknown if a decision support tool to identify inpatients at highest risk of bleeding can prevent critically low hemoglobin and its associated sequelae, such as requiring blood transfusion. Objective To create a decision support tool to identify hospitalized patients at high risk of bleeding sequelae (“high risk”) and to evaluate the impact of this tool on rates of critically low hemoglobin and blood transfusion. Methods We conducted a cohort study of patients hospitalized under general internal medicine at a tertiary-care teaching hospital in Toronto, Ontario. We defined “high risk” as patients with a hemoglobin < 86 g/L, or an absolute decrease in hemoglobin of ≥ 30 g/L, or a platelet count < 50 x 10 9 /L. We then created, implemented, and prospectively evaluated a decision support tool to identify these high-risk patients and alert their clinical team. Our primary outcome was the percentage of patients who received a blood transfusion. Results Our retrospective pre-deployment phase included 6,401 hospitalizations and our prospective phase included 4,274 hospitalizations. The median age of patients was 67 years (IQR 52,80), 43% were female, and the median length of stay was 5 days (IQR 2,10). Overall, 9% had a hemoglobin of 70 g/L or lower and 10% received a blood transfusion in hospital. After model implementation, the median timing of alerts was 1 day after admission (IQR 1,4). The most common trigger for an alert was a hemoglobin < 86 g/L (N=624, 76%), followed by a decrease in hemoglobin ≥ 30 g/L (N=131, 16%), and a platelet count < 50 x 10 9 /L (N=37, 5%). Deployment of the decision support tool was associated with a reduction in the primary outcome (OR 0.78, 95% CI 0.64, 0.96), which was driven by a reduction in red blood cell transfusion (OR 0.78, 95% CI 0.64, 0.96) as opposed to platelet transfusion (OR 1.10, 95% CI 0.46, 2.91). We also observed a reduction in our secondary outcome of critically low hemoglobin (OR 0.81, 95% CI 0.65, 0.99). Interpretation Our decision support tool was associated with a modest reduction in our primary outcome of blood transfusions and secondary outcome of critically low hemoglobin. Because our study was single-centre, we believe future larger studies are needed to validate our findings.

abstract_zh: 大语言模型在编码、推理和工具使用能力方面的最新进展激发了人们对图书馆学习的兴趣（即通过创建、存储和检索可重用和可组合函数、知识、清单或引理进行在线学习）。此类系统通常承诺通过自动创建广泛适用的工具来提高任务性能，并通过推理缓存（即生成的工具的存储）来提供卓越的计算性能。然而，我们有充分的理由对此表示怀疑。我们深入研究了这样一个系统：LEGO-Prover，它旨在学习可重复使用的引理以进行数学推理。我们没有找到直接重用学到的引理的证据，并再次找到证据......
abstract_en: Recent advancements in the coding, reasoning, and tool-using abilities of LLMs have spurred interest in library learning (i.e., online learning through the creation, storage, and retrieval of reusable and composable functions, knowledge, checklists, or lemmas). Such systems often promise improved task performance through the automatic creation of broadly applicable tools, as well as superior computational performance through the caching of reasoning (i.e., the storage of generated tools). However, we find strong reason to be skeptical. We perform a deep dive into one such system, LEGO-Prover, which purports to learn reusable lemmas for mathematical reasoning. We find no evidence of the direct reuse of learned lemmas, and find evidence against the soft reuse of learned lemmas (i.e., reuse by modifying relevant examples). Crucially, we find that LEGO-Prover does not in fact improve over the simple baseline of prompting the model - the improvements in task accuracy vanish once computational cost is accounted for. Our findings suggest that serious misconceptions exist as to the effectiveness of these techniques, that a serious re-examination of the state of LLM-based library learning is required, and that we require much stronger standards for evaluation including behavioural analysis and ensuring that an equal computational budget is used for baselines.

authors: Timur H. Latypov；Rose Yakubov；Daniel Jörgens；Pascale Tsai；Patcharaporn Srisaikaew；Peter Shih-Ping Hung；Matthew R Walker；Marina Tawfik；David John Mikulis；Frank Rudzicz；Mojgan Hodaie
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 慢性疼痛仍然是临床医生面临的一个挑战，能够帮助诊断、病程或预测治疗结果的个性化预测工具有限。我们假设，包含患者完整的疼痛相关临床数据、病史和脑成像的综合分析可以识别与手术结果相关的关键因素，并对三叉神经痛（TN）——慢性面部疼痛综合征的具体结果类别进行分层。我们使用有监督和无监督的机器学习方法，分析了 102 名经典 TN 受试者的数据。通过无监督学习处理术前临床数据，以描绘 TN 结果分层的关键临床因素及其正确性。
abstract_en: Chronic pain remains a challenge for clinicians, with limited individualized predictive tools that can aid with diagnosis, disease course, or prediction of treatment outcomes. We hypothesized that a comprehensive analysis, encompassing a patient's complete pain-related clinical data, medical history and brain imaging, can identify key contributors linked to surgical outcomes and stratify specific outcome categories for trigeminal neuralgia (TN)—chronic facial pain syndrome. Using supervised and unsupervised machine learning approaches, we analysed data from 102 subjects with classical TN. Pre-surgical clinical data were processed through unsupervised learning to delineate key clinical contributors of TN outcome stratification and their correlation with surgical response. Concurrently, we applied supervised learning to pre-surgical T1-weighted brain magnetic resonance imaging. Clinical data analysis uncovered pain and non-pain-related measures—including pain frequency, degree of medication relief, pain character, presence of diabetes and cancer history—as the most significant in forecasting surgical outcome. Analysis revealed strong correlation of pre-surgical clinical data with surgical response duration (r = 0.5, P < 0.00001). Imaging data analysis used a support vector machine classification model with high recall for subjects who would be either long-term responders or non-responders 0.79 and 0.86 with the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.86 and 0.84, respectively. The average multiclass accuracy in predicting the duration of surgical response categories was 78% (AUC 0.8). Together, these results show that TN surgical outcome categories are distinguishable, and surgical outcome can be stratified based on combined clinical and brain imaging data available prior to surgical treatment. We suggest a novel perspective on different strata of chronic pain disorders, each with structural imaging, clinical correlates and specific surgical outcomes.

title_zh: 市场预测的对比相似性学习：ContraSim 框架
title_en: Contrastive Similarity Learning for Market Forecasting: The ContraSim Framework
authors: Zining Zhu；Raeid Saqur；Frank Rudzicz；Nicholas Vinden
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 我们介绍了对比相似性空间嵌入算法（ContraSim），这是一种新颖的框架，用于揭示每日金融头条新闻和市场走势之间的全局语义关系。 ContraSim 分为两个关键阶段：(I) 加权标题增强，它生成增强的金融标题以及语义细粒度相似性评分；(II) 加权自监督对比学习 (WSSCL)，这是经典自监督对比学习的扩展版本，它使用相似性度量来创建精细的加权嵌入空间。这种嵌入空间将语义相似的标题聚集在一起，促进更深入的市场洞察。经验结果表明，集成 ContraSi...
abstract_en: We introduce the Contrastive Similarity Space Embedding Algorithm (ContraSim), a novel framework for uncovering the global semantic relationships between daily financial headlines and market movements. ContraSim operates in two key stages: (I) Weighted Headline Augmentation, which generates augmented financial headlines along with a semantic fine-grained similarity score, and (II) Weighted Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning (WSSCL), an extended version of classical self-supervised contrastive learning that uses the similarity metric to create a refined weighted embedding space. This embedding space clusters semantically similar headlines together, facilitating deeper market insights. Empirical results demonstrate that integrating ContraSim features into financial forecasting tasks improves classification accuracy from WSJ headlines by 7%. Moreover, leveraging an information density analysis, we find that the similarity spaces constructed by ContraSim intrinsically cluster days with homogeneous market movement directions, indicating that ContraSim captures market dynamics independent of ground truth labels. Additionally, ContraSim enables the identification of historical news days that closely resemble the headlines of the current day, providing analysts with actionable insights to predict market trends by referencing analogous past events.

title_zh: 探索 Human 和 GPT 用于汇总评估的功能
title_en: Exploring the features used for summary evaluation by Human and GPT
authors: Zahra Sadeghi；Frank Rudzicz；Evangelos E. Milios
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 摘要评估涉及评估生成的摘要如何反映源文本的关键思想和含义，需要对内容有深入的理解。大型语言模型（LLM）已被用来自动化这一过程，充当法官来评估相对于原始文本的摘要。虽然之前的研究调查了大语言模型和人类反应之间的一致性，但尚不清楚当被要求根据特定的质量维度进行评估时，它们会利用哪些属性或特征，并且对于评估分数和指标之间的映射也没有太多关注。在本文中，我们解决了这个问题并发现了与人类和生成预训练转换一致的特征......
abstract_en: Summary assessment involves evaluating how well a generated summary reflects the key ideas and meaning of the source text, requiring a deep understanding of the content. Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used to automate this process, acting as judges to evaluate summaries with respect to the original text. While previous research investigated the alignment between LLMs and Human responses, it is not yet well understood what properties or features are exploited by them when asked to evaluate based on a particular quality dimension, and there has not been much attention towards mapping between evaluation scores and metrics. In this paper, we address this issue and discover features aligned with Human and Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPTs) responses by studying statistical and machine learning metrics. Furthermore, we show that instructing GPTs to employ metrics used by Human can improve their judgment and conforming them better with human responses.

title_zh: 通过数据集集成增强滥用语言检测中的机器学习
title_en: Enhancing Machine Learning in Abusive Language Detection with Dataset Integration
venue: IEEE International Conference on Collaborative Advances in Software and Computing (CASCON)
authors: Samaneh Hosseini Moghaddam；Kelly Lyons；Cheryl Regehr；Frank Rudzicz；Vivek Goel；Kaitlyn Regehr
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 据广泛报道，滥用语言检测模型泛化性较差，限制了它们在现实世界中的有效性。这主要是由于数据集中的采样和词汇偏差造成的。针对这些问题，我们的目标是通过利用和统一现有数据集来增强滥用语言检测模型的通用性。我们根据辱骂性语言的一致定义协调了十个公开可用的数据集，并将它们集成到一个数据集中。我们的核心假设是，虽然各个数据集表现出抽样偏差，但可以利用它们的互补特征来创建更广泛、更具代表性的训练分布。为了评估这个假设，我们首先凭经验证明……
abstract_en: Abusive language detection models are widely reported to suffer from poor generalization, limiting their realworld effectiveness. This is largely due to sampling and lexical biases in datasets. In response to these issues, we aim to enhance the generalizability of abusive language detection models by leveraging and unifying existing datasets. We harmonize ten publicly available datasets under a consistent definition of abusive language and integrate them into a single dataset. Our core hypothesis is that while individual datasets exhibit sampling bias, their complementary characteristics can be harnessed to create a broader and more representative training distribution. To evaluate this hypothesis, we first empirically demonstrate the extent of sampling bias across datasets, then systematically integrate multiple datasets into an aggregated corpus and compare the classification performance of models trained on each individual dataset versus a model trained on the aggregated corpus using a held-out, uniformly sampled benchmark comprising data from all datasets. While the integrated model improves macro-F1 from 0.60 (average across single datasets) to 0.84. Furthermore, we quantify the contribution of each dataset to the integrated model's performance gains and its lexical dissimilarity relative to others, and find a strong correlation with a magnitude of 0.71. These findings suggest that integrating lexically diverse datasets exposes models to a broader spectrum of abuse-related language, mitigating dataset-specific sampling biases and enhancing model generalizability in real-world scenarios.

title_zh: 通过梯度矩阵去噪进行样本高效的差分隐私微调
title_en: Sample-Efficient Differentially Private Fine-Tuning via Gradient Matrix Denoising
authors: Frank Rudzicz；Ali Dadsetan
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 在敏感数据上微调大型语言模型 (LLM) 时，隐私是一个核心问题，而差分隐私随机梯度下降 (DP-SGD) 提供了正式的隐私保证。当固定隐私级别的性能在 GLUE 等既定基准上基本饱和时，我们会问是否可以用更少的计算达到相同的性能。理论和实践都表明，低秩模型更适合 DP 训练，这一特性与大语言模型尤其相关，其微调梯度表现出强大的低秩结构。 DP-LoRA 等方法通过将每一层的权重更新表示为仅几个非零秩一分量的总和来利用这一点。然而，我们认为虽然有很少的非零分量......
abstract_en: Privacy is a central concern when fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on sensitive data, and differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) provides formal privacy guarantees. When performance at a fixed privacy level largely saturates on established benchmarks such as GLUE, we ask whether the same performance can be reached with less computation. Both theory and practice show that lower-rank models are better suited to DP training, a property especially relevant for LLMs, whose fine-tuning gradients exhibit a strong low-rank structure. Methods such as DP-LoRA exploit this by expressing each layer's weight update as a sum of only a few non-zero rank-one components. However, we argue that while having few non-zero components is important, the isotropic noise injected by DP-SGD inflates the singular values of the gradient matrix, disrupting their naturally fast decay. We investigate whether this noise-induced spectral distortion slows optimization. Experiments on language classification (GLUE with RoBERTa) and table-to-text generation (E2E and DART with Qwen and Llama models up to 4B parameters) show that partially restoring the original singular-value profile significantly accelerates DP-SGD convergence without compromising privacy guarantees. Our code is available at https://github.com/alidadsetan/re-exam-private-low-rank.

title_zh: 值得信赖的医疗问答：以评估为中心的调查
title_en: Trustworthy Medical Question Answering: An Evaluation-Centric Survey
authors: Baiyang Wang；Pengjie Ren；Xindi Wang；Yinuo Wang；Frank Rudzicz；Sudipta Singha Roy；Robert E. Mercer；Zhumin Chen
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 医疗保健问答 (QA) 系统的可信度对于确保患者安全、临床有效性和用户信心非常重要。随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地融入医疗环境，其响应的可靠性直接影响临床决策和患者治疗结果。然而，由于医疗数据固有的复杂性、临床场景的关键性以及可信人工智能的多方面性，在医疗质量保证中实现全面的可信度带来了重大挑战。在这项调查中，我们系统地研究了医学质量保证可信度的六个关键维度，即事实性、稳健性、公平性、安全性、可解释性和校准。 ...
abstract_en: Trustworthiness in healthcare question-answering (QA) systems is important for ensuring patient safety, clinical effectiveness, and user confidence. As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly integrated into medical settings, the reliability of their responses directly influences clinical decision-making and patient outcomes. However, achieving comprehensive trustworthiness in medical QA poses significant challenges due to the inherent complexity of healthcare data, the critical nature of clinical scenarios, and the multifaceted dimensions of trustworthy AI. In this survey, we systematically examine six key dimensions of trustworthiness in medical QA, i.e., Factuality, Robustness, Fairness, Safety, Explainability, and Calibration. We review how each dimension is evaluated in existing LLM-based medical QA systems. We compile and compare major benchmarks designed to assess these dimensions and analyze evaluation-guided techniques that drive model improvements, such as retrieval-augmented grounding, adversarial fine-tuning, and safety alignment. Finally, we identify open challenges-such as scalable expert evaluation, integrated multi-dimensional metrics, and real-world deployment studies-and propose future research directions to advance the safe, reliable, and transparent deployment of LLM-powered medical QA.

title_zh: 终究没有迷失：交叉编码器归因如何挑战 LLM 总结中的定位偏差假设
title_en: Not Lost After All: How Cross-Encoder Attribution Challenges Position Bias Assumptions in LLM Summarization
authors: Elham Dolatabadi；Domenic Rosati；Frank Rudzicz；Abeer Badawi；Hassan Sajjad；Elahe Rahimi
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 位置偏差，即大型语言模型 (LLM) 根据其在文档中的结构位置而不是语义相关性来选择内容的趋势，已被视为自动摘要的关键限制。为了测量位置偏差，先前的研究严重依赖 n 元语法匹配技术，该技术无法捕获内容被广泛改写的抽象摘要中的语义关系。为了解决这一限制，我们应用了一种基于交叉编码器的对齐方法，该方法联合处理摘要-源句子对，即使在摘要实质上重写了源代码。在六个摘要数据集上对五个大语言模型进行的实验揭示了显着的差异...
abstract_en: Position bias, the tendency of Large Language Models (LLMs) to select content based on its structural position in a document rather than its semantic relevance, has been viewed as a key limitation in automatic summarization.To measure position bias, prior studies rely heavily on n-gram matching techniques, which fail to capture semantic relationships in abstractive summaries where content is extensively rephrased.To address this limitation, we apply a crossencoder-based alignment method that jointly processes summary-source sentence pairs, enabling more accurate identification of semantic correspondences even when summaries substantially rewrite the source.Experiments with five LLMs across six summarization datasets reveal significantly different position bias patterns than those reported by traditional metrics.Our findings suggest that these patterns primarily reflect rational adaptations to document structure and content rather than true model limitations.Through controlled experiments and analyses across varying document lengths and multi-document settings, we show that LLMs use content from all positions more effectively than previously assumed, challenging common claims about "lost-in-the-middle" behaviour.

title_zh: CausalLink：因果推理的交互式评估框架
title_en: CausalLink: An Interactive Evaluation Framework for Causal Reasoning
authors: Jinyue Feng；Frank Rudzicz
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 我们提出了 CausalLink，一种创新的评估框架，可以交互式地评估因果推理技能，以识别会话语言模型中的正确干预。每个 CausalLink 测试用例都会创建一个假设环境，在该环境中，指示语言模型对实体应用干预措施，这些实体的交互遵循从可控因果图生成的预定义因果关系。我们的评估框架将因果能力与世界知识和语义线索的混杂效应隔离开来。我们以以下方式评估一系列大语言模型：场景以几何形状的运动为特征，并发现模型开始对 140 亿参数规模的两个或三个变量表现出可靠的推理。然而……
abstract_en: We present CausalLink, an innovative evaluation framework that interactively assesses the causal reasoning skill to identify the correct intervention in conversational language models.Each CausalLink test case creates a hypothetical environment in which the language models are instructed to apply interventions to entities whose interactions follow predefined causal relations generated from controllable causal graphs.Our evaluation framework isolates causal capabilities from the confounding effects of world knowledge and semantic cues.We evaluate a series of LLMs in a scenario featuring movements of geometric shapes and discover that models start to exhibit reliable reasoning on two or three variables at the 14-billion-parameter scale.However, the performance of state-of-the-art models such as GPT4o degrades below random chance as the number of variables increases.We identify and analyze several key failure modes.

title_zh: MedSynth：现实的综合医学对话笔记对
title_en: MedSynth: Realistic, Synthetic Medical Dialogue-Note Pairs
authors: Frank Rudzicz；Ahmad Rezaie Mianroodi；Cyril Rakovski；Amirali Rezaie；Niko Grisel Todorov
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 医生花费大量时间记录临床经历，这种负担会导致职业倦怠。为了解决这个问题，强大的医疗文档自动化工具至关重要。我们介绍 MedSynth——一个新颖的合成医学对话和笔记数据集，旨在推进对话到笔记 (Dial-2-Note) 和笔记到对话 (Note-2-Dial) 任务。通过对疾病分布的广泛分析，该数据集包含 10,000 多个对话注释对，涵盖 2000 多个 ICD-10 代码。我们证明，我们的数据集显着提高了模型在从对话生成医疗笔记以及从医疗笔记生成对话方面的性能。该数据集在开放获取、p...的领域提供了宝贵的资源。
abstract_en: Physicians spend significant time documenting clinical encounters, a burden that contributes to professional burnout. To address this, robust automation tools for medical documentation are crucial. We introduce MedSynth -- a novel dataset of synthetic medical dialogues and notes designed to advance the Dialogue-to-Note (Dial-2-Note) and Note-to-Dialogue (Note-2-Dial) tasks. Informed by an extensive analysis of disease distributions, this dataset includes over 10,000 dialogue-note pairs covering over 2000 ICD-10 codes. We demonstrate that our dataset markedly enhances the performance of models in generating medical notes from dialogues, and dialogues from medical notes. The dataset provides a valuable resource in a field where open-access, privacy-compliant, and diverse training data are scarce. Code is available at https://github.com/ahmadrezarm/MedSynth/tree/main and the dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ahmad0067/MedSynth.

title_zh: MLHOps：机器学习健康运营
title_en: MLHOps: Machine Learning Health Operations
authors: Amrit Krishnan；Faiza Khan Khattak；Chloé Pou-Prom；Sedef Akinli Koçak；Elham Dolatabadi；Frank Rudzicz；Laleh Seyyed-Kalantari；Vallijah Subasri；Deval Pandya
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 机器学习健康运营 (MLHOps) 是在医疗保健环境中可靠、高效、可用且合乎道德地部署和维护机器学习模型的流程组合。本文提供了该领域的工作调查，并为开发人员和临床医生在临床实践中部署和维护自己的模型提供了指南。我们涵盖了一般机器学习操作的基本概念，并描述了 MLHOps 管道的初始设置（包括数据源、准备、工程和工具）。然后，我们描述长期监控和更新（包括数据分布变化和模型更新）和道德考虑（包括偏见、公平性、可解释性和隐私）。这世...
abstract_en: Machine Learning Health Operations (MLHOps) is the combination of processes for reliable, efficient, usable, and ethical deployment and maintenance of machine learning models in healthcare settings. This paper provides both a survey of work in this area and guidelines for developers and clinicians to deploy and maintain their own models in clinical practice. We cover the foundational concepts of general machine learning operations and describe the initial setup of MLHOps pipelines (including data sources, preparation, engineering, and tools). We then describe long-term monitoring and updating (including data distribution shifts and model updating) and ethical considerations (including bias, fairness, interpretability, and privacy). This work therefore provides guidance across the full pipeline of MLHOps from conception to initial and ongoing deployment. We also include a checklist to ensure thorough verification of each step in the process.

title_zh: SoftAdaClip：公平和私密模型训练的平滑裁剪策略
title_en: SoftAdaClip: A Smooth Clipping Strategy for Fair and Private Model Training
authors: Frank Rudzicz；Ali Dadsetan；Dorsa Soleymani
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 差分隐私 (DP) 为敏感数据提供了强有力的保护，但通常会降低模型性能和公平性，特别是对于代表性不足的群体。一个主要原因是 DP-SGD 中的梯度裁剪，它会不成比例地抑制少数群体的学习信号。尽管自适应裁剪可以增强实用性，但它仍然依赖于统一的硬裁剪，这可能会限制公平性。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 SoftAdaClip，这是一种差分隐私训练方法，它用基于 tanh 的平滑变换代替硬剪裁，以在限制灵敏度的同时保留相对梯度幅度。我们在各种数据集上评估 SoftAdaClip，包括 MIMIC-III（临床文本）、GOSSIS-eICU（结构化医疗保健）...
abstract_en: Differential privacy (DP) provides strong protection for sensitive data, but often reduces model performance and fairness, especially for underrepresented groups. One major reason is gradient clipping in DP-SGD, which can disproportionately suppress learning signals for minority subpopulations. Although adaptive clipping can enhance utility, it still relies on uniform hard clipping, which may restrict fairness. To address this, we introduce SoftAdaClip, a differentially private training method that replaces hard clipping with a smooth, tanh-based transformation to preserve relative gradient magnitudes while bounding sensitivity. We evaluate SoftAdaClip on various datasets, including MIMIC-III (clinical text), GOSSIS-eICU (structured healthcare), and Adult Income (tabular data). Our results show that SoftAdaClip reduces subgroup disparities by up to 87% compared to DP-SGD and up to 48% compared to Adaptive-DPSGD, and these reductions in subgroup disparities are statistically significant. These findings underscore the importance of integrating smooth transformations with adaptive mechanisms to achieve fair and private model training.

abstract_zh: 重度抑郁症（MDD）表现出异质的症状特征和高复发风险。了解症状相互作用与重度抑郁症复发的关系可能会增强维持策略。因此，我们研究了抑郁症状网络的连通性与重度抑郁症复发的关系。我们分析了 87 名 MDD 缓解患者的纵向数据，这些患者平均随访 12 个月。使用应用于抑郁症状快速清单的每周自我评级的多级图形向量自回归来估计患者水平的症状网络。我们计算了患者特定的网络连接指数，包括症状网络密度 (SND)、顶点覆盖 (VC) 大小和最小支配集 (MDS) 大小……
abstract_en: Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) demonstrates heterogeneous symptom profiles and a high relapse risk. Understanding how symptom interactions relate to relapse in MDD may enhance maintenance strategies. We thus investigated how connectivity in depressive symptom networks relates to relapse in MDD. We analyzed longitudinal data from 87 patients with remitted MDD who were followed for an average of 12 months. Patient-level symptom networks were estimated using multilevel graphical vector autoregression applied to weekly self-ratings of the Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology. We calculated patient-specific network connectivity indices, including symptom network density (SND), vertex cover (VC) size, and minimal dominating set (MDS) size. Cox proportional hazards models assessed associations between these indices and time to relapse, controlling for baseline symptom severity. Higher SND and larger VC size were significantly associated with an increased relapse risk (HR for SND = 2.03, 95 % CI [1.44, 2.87], p < 0.001; HR for VC = 2.77, 95 % CI [1.79, 4.30], p < 0.001). Conversely, a larger MDS size was associated with a lower risk of relapse (HR 0.47, 95 % CI [0.31, 0.70], p < 0.001). Exploratory analyses showed that the strength centrality of sadness, difficulty concentrating, pessimism, suicidality, and low interest portend a higher relapse risk. Hyperconnectivity among depressive symptom networks may indicate vulnerability to relapse in MDD. Our results further support the potential utility of symptom network-based analyses for predicting outcomes in MDD. Future studies should evaluate whether symptom network-based analyses can provide markers for personalized treatment planning.

title_zh: 表示噪声：针对有害微调的防御机制

authors: Domenic Rosati；Carsten Maple；Subhabrata Majumdar；Frank Rudzicz；Robie Gonzales；Lukasz Bartoszcze；Jan Wehner；Hassan Sajjad；Kai Williams
