title_zh: Towards a Heuristic Categorization of Prepositional Phrases in English with WordNet
title_en: Towards a Heuristic Categorization of Prepositional Phrases in English with WordNet
authors: Frank Rudzicz；Serguei A. Mokhov
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 本文件讨论了 PP 自动分类的方法及其基本实现；这个话题在 NLP 中并没有像 NP 和 VP 那样受到那么多关注。该方法是一种基于规则的启发式方法，在我们的研究的多个层面中进行了概述。本文档中考虑了 7 个 PP 语义类别，我们可以从带注释的语料库中对它们进行分类。
abstract_en: This document discusses an approach and its rudimentary realization towards automatic classification of PPs; the topic, that has not received as much attention in NLP as NPs and VPs. The approach is a rule-based heuristics outlined in several levels of our research. There are 7 semantic categories of PPs considered in this document that we are able to classify from an annotated corpus.

title_zh: 构音障碍语音判别分类中的语音特征
title_en: Phonological features in discriminative classification of dysarthric speech
authors: Frank Rudzicz
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 为了克服与发音限制和生成模型相关的问题，这项工作考虑在残疾语音的判别模型中使用语音特征。具体来说，我们训练前馈和循环神经网络以及径向基和序列内核支持向量机来抽象声道，并将这些模型应用于构音障碍语音的电话识别。结果表明，与标准隐马尔可夫模型相比，这种方法的相对误差减少了 1.5% 到 10.9%，并且所有分类器的说话人清晰度的准确性都得到了提高。这项工作可以应用于患有构音障碍的说话者的辅助软件组件中。
abstract_en: In an attempt to overcome problems associated with articulatory limitations and generative models, this work considers the use of phonological features in discriminative models for disabled speech. Specifically, we train feed-forward and recurrent neural networks, and radial basis and sequence-kernel support vector machines to abstractions of the vocal tract, and apply these models to phone recognition on dysarthric speech. The results show relative error reduction of between 1.5% and 10.9% with this approach against standard hidden Markov modeling, and increases in accuracy with speaker intelligibility across all classifiers. This work may be applied within components of assistive software for speakers with dysarthria.

title_zh: 将离散发音知识应用于构音障碍语音
title_en: Applying discretized articulatory knowledge to dysarthric speech
authors: Frank Rudzicz
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 本文应用两个动态贝叶斯网络（分别包括声道的理论和测量运动学特征）来完成未分段构音障碍语音中音素序列的标记任务。这些模型的依赖于说话者和自适应的版本与两个纯声学基线（即隐藏马尔可夫模型和潜在动态条件随机场）进行比较。声道的理论模型和运动学模型在依赖于说话者的语音上都表现出色，并且我们表明后者的统计数据在适应过程中不一定可以在说话者之间转移。
abstract_en: This paper applies two dynamic Bayes networks that include theoretical and measured kinematic features of the vocal tract, respectively, to the task of labeling phoneme sequences in unsegmented dysarthric speech. Speaker dependent and adaptive versions of these models are compared against two acoustic-only baselines, namely a hidden Markov model and a latent dynamic conditional random field. Both theoretical and kinematic models of the vocal tract perform admirably on speaker-dependent speech, and we show that the statistics of the latter are not necessarily transferable between speakers during adaptation.

title_zh: 总结多个口头文件：从未转录的音频中寻找证据
title_en: Summarizing multiple spoken documents: finding evidence from untranscribed audio
authors: Frank Rudzicz；Gerald Penn；Xiaodan Zhu
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种总结多个未转录语音文档的模型。在不假设转录本可用性的情况下，该模型修改了最近提出的无监督算法来检测语音中重复出现的声学模式，并使用它们来估计话语之间的相似性，进而用于识别显着话语并消除冗余。该模型之所以引起人们的兴趣，是因为它独立于口语转录，这是一个容易出错且资源密集型的过程，它能够集成同一主题的多个信息源，并且它对声学模式的新颖使用扩展了先前在低级韵律特征检测方面的工作。我们将该模型的性能与...进行比较
abstract_en: This paper presents a model for summarizing multiple untranscribed spoken documents. Without assuming the availability of transcripts, the model modifies a recently proposed unsupervised algorithm to detect re-occurring acoustic patterns in speech and uses them to estimate similarities between utterances, which are in turn used to identify salient utterances and remove redundancies. This model is of interest due to its independence from spoken language transcription, an error-prone and resource-intensive process, its ability to integrate multiple sources of information on the same topic, and its novel use of acoustic patterns that extends previous work on low-level prosodic feature detection. We compare the performance of this model with that achieved using manual and automatic transcripts, and find that this new approach is roughly equivalent to having access to ASR transcripts with word error rates in the 33--37% range without actually having to do the ASR, plus it better handles utterances with out-of-vocabulary words.

title_zh: 构音障碍的比较数据库
title_en: Towards a Comparative Database of Dysarthric Articulation
authors: Frank Rudzicz；Pascal H. H. M. Van Lieshout；Graeme Hirst；Gerald Penn；Fraser Shein；Talya Wolff
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 这项工作描述了构音障碍语音的同步声学和运动学特征的持续数据收集。记录包括电磁关节描记测量和根据脑瘫患者和匹配的非构音障碍受试者阅读的各种提示的视频进行的 3D 重建。初步结果显示，构音障碍语音中爆破音的发音错误较多，并且发音变异性较大。使用标准隐马尔可夫模型进行语音识别的实验显示，对于非构音障碍语音的三音素识别准确度为 84%，但对于脑瘫患者的识别准确度仅为 6%。
abstract_en: This work describes ongoing data collection of synchronized acoustic and kinematic features of dysarthric speech. Recordings consist of electromagnetic articulographic measurements and 3D reconstructions from video over a variety prompts read by individuals with cerebral palsy and matching nondysarthric subjects. Preliminary results show a preponderance of mispronounced plosives in dysarthric speech, and greater articulatory variability. An experiment with a standard hidden Markov model for speech recognition resulted in 84 % triphone recognition accuracy for non-dysarthric speech, but only 6 % accuracy for individuals with cerebral palsy.

title_zh: 通过近似格表示对口语话语检索的批判性评估
title_en: A critical assessment of spoken utterance retrieval through approximate lattice representations
authors: Frank Rudzicz；Cosmin Munteanu；Siavash Kazemian；Gerald Penn
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 本文比较了应用于语音检索的位置特定后格（PSPL）和混淆网络的性能，并根据两个不同领域的几个基线测试了这些最新的建议。这些有损方法提供了紧凑的表示，可以概括原始片段网格并提供更好的召回率和鲁棒性，但尚未在多个 WER 条件下进行相互评估以进行语音检索。我们的比较表明，虽然 PSPL 和混淆网络具有可比的召回率，但前者稍微更精确，尽管它的优点似乎与低频搜索查询和低 WER 环境的假设相结合。
abstract_en: This paper compares the performance of position-specific posterior lattices (PSPL) and confusion networks applied to spoken utterance retrieval, and tests these recent proposals against several baselines in two disparate domains. These lossy methods provide compact representations that generalize the original segment lattices and provide greater recall and robustness, but have yet to be evaluated against each other in multiple WER conditions for spoken utterance retrieval. Our comparisons suggest that while PSPL and confusion networks have comparable recall, the former is slightly more precise, although its merit appears to be coupled to the assumptions of low-frequency search queries and low-WER environments.

title_zh: 比较用于识别构音障碍语音的说话者相关声学模型和说话者自适应声学模型
title_en: Comparing speaker-dependent and speaker-adaptive acoustic models for recognizing dysarthric speech
authors: Frank Rudzicz
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 构音障碍语音的声学建模因其说话者内部和说话者之间变异性的增加而变得复杂。在这项任务中，比较了依赖于说话者的模型和说话者自适应模型的准确性，后者在不同级别的说话者清晰度中占主导地位。
abstract_en: Acoustic modeling of dysarthric speech is complicated by its increased intra- and inter-speaker variability. The accuracy of speaker-dependent and speaker-adaptive models are compared for this task, with the latter prevailing across varying levels of speaker intelligibility.

title_zh: 这里放一个语法：多模态交互中的双向解析
title_en: Put a grammar here: bi-directional parsing in multimodal interaction
authors: Frank Rudzicz
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 尽管进行了二十多年的研究，但尚未出现普遍代表多模态交互（MMI）中语言的主导范式。然而，许多不同方法之间的一个共同点是明显不愿意将多模态语言视为一种独特的语言现象，这导致计算模型被改造为旧方法，并且集成引擎与其应用程序相关。在本文中，我们提出了 GS 算法 - 一种新的基于语法的 MMI 统一解析器，并讨论了其含义和正在进行的分析。
abstract_en: Despite over two decades of research, no dominant paradigm has yet emerged to generically represent language in multimodal interaction (MMI). A commonality amongst many divergent approaches, however, is an apparent reluctance to treat multimodal language as a unique linguistic phenomenon, which results in computational models retrofitted to older approaches, and integration engines tied to their application. In this paper we present the GS Algorithm - a new grammar-based unification parser for MMI, and discuss its implications and ongoing analysis.

title_zh: Clavius：通用多模态交互的双向解析
title_en: Clavius: Bi-Directional Parsing for Generic Multimodal Interaction
authors: Frank Rudzicz
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
topics: 多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 我们在统一语法上引入了一种新的多线程解析算法，专为多模态交互和噪声环境而设计。通过解除一些传统的约束，即与成分排序相关的约束，我们克服了该领域其他系统的几个困难。我们还提出了该模型中使用的几个标准，以使用动态可加载评分函数来约束搜索过程。讨论了我们实施的一些早期分析。
abstract_en: We introduce a new multi-threaded parsing algorithm on unification grammars designed specifically for multimodal interaction and noisy environments. By lifting some traditional constraints, namely those related to the ordering of constituents, we overcome several difficulties of other systems in this domain. We also present several criteria used in this model to constrain the search process using dynamically loadable scoring functions. Some early analyses of our implementation are discussed.

title_zh: 使用不受束缚的双手手势界面在沉浸式空间中进行 3D 可视化和操作的框架
title_en: A framework for 3D visualisation and manipulation in an immersive space using an untethered bimanual gestural interface
authors: Frank Rudzicz；Jeremy R. Cooperstock；Michael Wozniewski；François Rioux；Yves Boussemart
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 沉浸式环境为用户提供沉浸在虚拟空间中的体验，有效地超越了现实与虚拟世界之间的界限。我们提出了一个用于 3D 虚拟环境的可视化和操作的框架，在该框架中，用户无需诉诸传统键盘和鼠标交互的尴尬命令词汇。我们采用了透明工具玻璃范例作为手势界面小部件，以实现空间沉浸式环境。为了实现这一目的，我们实现了一个双手手势解释器来识别用户的操作并将其转换为用于控制这些小部件的命令。为了满足让用户完全不受束缚的主要设计目标，我们使用纯粹的视频...
abstract_en: Immersive Environments offer users the experience of being submerged in a virtual space, effectively transcending the boundary between the real and virtual world. We present a framework for visualization and manipulation of 3D virtual environments in which users need not resort to the awkward command vocabulary of traditional keyboard-and-mouse interaction. We have adapted the transparent toolglass paradigm as a gestural interface widget for a spatially immersive environment. To serve that purpose, we have implemented a bimanual gesture interpreter to recognize and translate a user's actions into commands for control of these widgets. In order to satisfy a primary design goal of keeping the user completely untethered, we use purely video-based tracking techniques.

title_zh: {Using Knowledge-poor Coreference Resolution for Text Summarization}
title_en: {Using Knowledge-poor Coreference Resolution for Text Summarization}
authors: Sabine Bergler；René Witte；Michelle Khalifé；Zhuoyan Li；Frank Rudzicz；Yunyu Chen；Monia Doandes；Alina Andreevskaia；Ralf Krestel；Sylvain Bellemare
primary_category: 脑电基础大模型与自监督预训练
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个系统，该系统基于输出代表最重要文本实体的名词短语（由名词短语共指链表示）的单一摘要策略来生成 10 个单词的摘要。使用模糊集理论与知识匮乏的共指启发法相结合来计算共指链。 1
abstract_en: We present a system that produces 10-word summaries based on the single summarization strategy of outputting noun phrases representing the most important text entities (as represented by noun phrase coreference chains). The coreference chains were computed using fuzzy set theory combined with knowledgepoor corefernce heuristics. 1
